Summary of the Survival Models Fitted by fit_survival_models()

Source: R/summary.survfitsummary.R
summary.survfitsummary.Rd

The summary() method of the object returned by fit_survival_models: the fit statistics of gof_table for all the models, with their status, including the models that failed (whose statistics are NA). The warnings and errors themselves are printed by print.survfitsummary.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'survfitsummary'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

Object returned by fit_survival_models.

...

Not used.

Value

A data frame with one row per model and the columns fit_type, arm, model, status ("ok", "warning" or "error"), n, events, npars, loglik, AIC and BIC, sorted by AIC within each fit as in gof_table, with the models that failed last.

Examples

dat <- processing_dataset(
  system.file("extdata", "fit_example.csv", package = "SurvFitSummary"),
  column_arm = "TRT01P", column_survtime = "AVAL", column_cnsr = "CNSR",
  control_arm = "Control"
)
fits <- fit_survival_models(dat, distributions = c("exp", "weibull",
                                                   "llogis"),
                            spline_scales = NULL)
summary(fits)
#>      fit_type       arm        model status   n events npars     loglik
